scene: The kettle releases sparkling steam that parts the back workshop wall.
picture: Side view of the opened workshop wall revealing transit docks along one level floor. Far left hangs a round bamboo cable car with open sliding doors. Left stands the smoking copper kettle. Centre, an escalator rises upward beside you in your red bomber jacket. Far right waits a yellow noodle-cart monorail.
shown: a wicker bamboo cable car cabin hanging stationary at a platform far left
a humming metal escalator ascending steeply through a skylight opening in the centre
a yellow bowl-shaped noodle monorail car waiting beside an open hatch far right
